verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is a CLI/binary that runs headlessly with --fail exit codes and --json output, confirmed by a hands-on probe running the scan and version check without any UI or account, plus documented CI-friendly flags (--include-detectors, --fail, --results) and pre-commit/pre-receive hook docs for automation pipelines. missing for 10: no first-party CI pipeline templates (e.g. GitHub Actions/GitLab CI yaml) or independent CI-integration report in the evidence.
